parameters.name: CompressMethod
parameters.description:
The compression algorithm. Valid values:

- octree: octree

- kdtree: K-d tree

parameters.name: CredentialConfig
parameters.description:
**Leave this parameter empty unless you have special requirements.**

The China authorization configuration. This parameter is optional. For more information, see [Use chained authorization to access resources of other entities](~~465340~~).

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description:
The message notification configuration. For more information, click Notification. For information about the format of asynchronous notification messages, see [Asynchronous notification message format](~~2743997~~).

> Intelligent Media Management does not support specifying a callback URL for API call callbacks. Use Message Service (MNS) instead.
>

parameters.name: PointCloudFields
parameters.description:
The PCD attribute fields that participate in compression and the compression order. After compression, data is decompressed in this order.

- If you use PCL library octree compression, \["xyz"] is supported.

- If you use Draco library K-d tree compression, \["xyz"] or \["xyz", "intensity"] is supported.

parameters.name: PointCloudFileFormat
parameters.description: The point cloud file format. Only PCD format is supported. Default value: pcd.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: SourceURI
parameters.description:
The OSS URI of the point cloud file.

The OSS URI follows the format oss://${Bucket}/${Object}, where `${Bucket}` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `${Object}` is the full path of the file including the file name extension.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The custom tags that are used to search for and filter asynchronous tasks.

parameters.name: TargetURI
parameters.description:
The OSS URI of the compressed output file.

The OSS URI follows the format oss://${Bucket}/${Object}, where `${Bucket}` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `${Object}` is the full path of the file including the file name extension.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom information, which is returned in asynchronous message notifications to help you associate message notifications within your system. Maximum length: 2,048 bytes.
